//! Writes databases whose tables name a column after the row identity, which
//! builds from before the name was reserved let a table do
use stoolap::Database;

fn main() {
    let out = std::env::args().nth(1).expect("an output directory");
    // column_named_rowid: the table holds the column as it closes
    let db = Database::open(&format!("file://{out}/column_named_rowid")).unwrap();
    db.execute("CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, _rowid_ INTEGER)", ()).unwrap();
    db.execute("INSERT INTO t VALUES (1, 10), (2, 20)", ()).unwrap();
    db.close().unwrap();
    // snapshot_named_rowid: a snapshot holds the column, the table renamed it since
    let db = Database::open(&format!("file://{out}/snapshot_named_rowid")).unwrap();
    db.execute("CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, _rowid_ INTEGER)", ()).unwrap();
    db.execute("INSERT INTO t VALUES (1, 10), (2, 20)", ()).unwrap();
    db.execute("PRAGMA SNAPSHOT", ()).unwrap();
    db.execute("ALTER TABLE t RENAME COLUMN _rowid_ TO b", ()).unwrap();
    db.close().unwrap();
}
